Graphs… They are by far one of the hardest topics in Leetcode and if you ever wanna end up in FAANG, this is un-skippable.
I tried to cover all the topic that you need under graphs and trees and by the end of this blog, you will be confident to atleast identify what the problem wants.
The goal isn’t to memorize hundreds of problems. It’s to build the intuition to look at a question and immediately think, “This is a BFS problem,” or “This needs Union-Find,” or “Topological Sort is the key here.”
Not a member? Read from here
The decision tree
Is it a tree?
├── Need every node processed by levels? → BFS (level order)
├── Need to combine results from children? → DFS post-order (bottom-up)
├── Need to carry info from root down? → DFS pre-order (top-down)
└── It's a BST? → exploit sorted in-orderIs it a general graph?
├── Just need to visit / count components? → DFS or BFS
├── Shortest path, unweighted? → BFS
├── Shortest path, weighted non-negative? → Dijkstra
├── Shortest path, negative edges…
